physicalNotes: Radius 0.13471341 Jupiter radii from Piaulet et al. 2023 (2023NatAs...7..206P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023NatAs...7..206P/abstract): 9,630.9 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.00723661 Jupiter masses (Piaulet et al. 2023, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2023NatAs...7..206P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023NatAs...7..206P/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM.
